The '''YH-33''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Hyrotii Corporation/Legends|Hyrotii Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Hyrotii YH-33 was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[July 22]], [[2015]] as part of the Outer Rim Explorer's Pack.
